_comment: For a Cart or Checkout part whose settings are older than the look table, the look-table row (selectors.json rows) whose selector finds that part on the live page. A part whose name is a row's id with hyphens for underscores needs no entry. The verify pass (lib/part-look-verify.mjs) reads the live page through these selectors; a part with neither a row nor an entry is not verified and says so (so is a block's own part whose block.json element declares no selector). `blocks` names, per block, the live selector of a part of the block's own whose block.json element has no selector or prints another selector in the mode the route writes: the cart's root element (the class sgs-cart in src/blocks/cart/render.php `$wrapper_classes`) and its drawer scrim (the shared `sgs-scrim` element carries only a per-instance class of its own, so it is found by its `data-sgs-scrim-open` value naming the cart's drawer: includes/helpers-scrim.php::sgs_scrim_render, called from render.php), the product card's root (a wrapper element, so its block.json element declares no selector; the class `product-card` is in every mode's `$classes` in plugins/sgs-blocks/src/blocks/product-card/render.php) and its wishlist heart (a declared selector would make plugins/sgs-blocks/scripts/generate-motion-base-transitions.py look for the rule `.sgs-product-card .sgs-product-card__wishlist` and drop the heart's base transition from includes/motion/data/base-transitions.json, so the element declares none; the class is printed by includes/product-card-live-fill.php::sgs_product_card_wishlist_markup), the signed-in account views, read with ordersRowList and orderDetailLook on (plugins/sgs-blocks/includes/account/helpers-account-orders-list.php::sgs_account_orders_list_html, helpers-account-order-detail.php::sgs_account_order_detail_html), where the orders are a list of rows and an order has its own page; and the buy box's two built-in buttons, because the flow opener wears Add to Cart's own class `buybox__add-to-cart` (plugins/sgs-blocks/includes/buybox-linked-flow.php::sgs_buybox_flow_opener_html), so the element selector of `add-to-cart` would read the opener first.
